policies.context: Cross-department access to core treasury ledgers and wire batches by unauthorized UID/GID groups is prohibited. File permissions must strictly enforce 0o600 or 0o640.
Settlement logs and ACH streams must not be stored with raw deflate/zlib compression without an encryption envelope (AES-256-CBC).
Electronic Codebook (ECB) cipher mode leaks block repetition patterns and is prohibited across all transactional ledgers.
